questions.q: Which Datalogic scanner is the lead replacement for the Zebra DS9308?
questions.e: The Magellan 900i is the lead presentation scanner and IOR's like-for-like DS9308 replacement — what we stock and demo.

questions.q: What screen sizes does the Posbank BigPos kiosk come in?
questions.e: BigPos is offered in 21.5" and 27". (The Mazic K kiosk is the 15.6"/21.5" line.)

questions.q: Which two Honeywell SKUs are IOR's biggest earners, together over half of Honeywell revenue?
o: Voyager XP 1472g cordless 2D and Orbit MS7120 presentation
questions.e: The 1472g cordless 2D kit (~£50k) and the MS7120 Orbit presentation scanner (~£50k) are neck-and-neck at the top.

questions.q: Which interface ships as standard on the BV420D but is a paid option on the Zebra ZD421?
questions.e: Every BV420D includes USB plus 10/100 Ethernet as standard; on the ZD421 Ethernet is a paid extra.

questions.q: Which set of interfaces does Datalogic offer that Zebra does not match?
o: USB-HID, serial, and virtual serial COM
questions.e: Bench-test point 5: Datalogic supports USB-HID, serial and virtual serial COM; Zebra is USB or serial only.

questions.q: A customer's retail counter has a Zebra DS9308 presentation scanner. What does IOR transition them to?
questions.e: The DS9308 is IOR's single biggest displacement target. The standard replacement is the Datalogic Magellan 900i, with the Magellan 1500i as the premium step-up.

questions.q: The Zebra ZD421 has more standard memory than the BV420D. When does that actually matter?
o: Only for very large on-device font libraries or extensive stored label formats
questions.e: The extra memory only matters for large Unicode font sets or many stored formats; standard retail, logistics and healthcare labelling never approaches the BV420D's limits.

questions.q: Which best-attach accessory shows up most in Posbank sales volume?
questions.e: The 10" 2nd LCD and the MSR sell in high volume as attachments to Apexa terminals.

questions.q: Which of these Honeywell scanners can read a barcode off a phone screen?
questions.e: The 7190g is the hybrid 1D/2D presentation scanner. The 1200g, MS7120 and Eclipse are single-line lasers and physically cannot read screens — no setting changes that.

questions.q: A PCAP touch screen is registering presses nobody made. What are the three usual causes?
o: Worn touch layer, wrong driver, old firmware
Moisture on the glass, a grounding problem, or the touch-controller cable
Screen burn, dead pixels, backlight failure
questions.e: Ghost touch on PCAP is nearly always liquid on the glass (including a wet cloth or condensation), poor earthing in the supply or mounting, or a damaged or misseated controller cable — not a failing panel.

questions.scenario: A multi-site café chain is rolling out iPad-based cloud POS and wants a small, wireless receipt printer beside each tablet, with cabling kept to a minimum.
questions.q: Which Epson model do you lead with?
questions.e: The TM-m30III is built for tablet/cloud POS: USB-C power/tethering over one cable, integrated Bluetooth/Wi-Fi, tiny footprint, ePOS-Print for cloud apps.
